en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's play basketball
Ah, maybe we should take off our clothes...?
Let's warm up a bit

You got guts to challenge 
me at basketball!

Didn't I tell you?
My basketball skills are universe-tier.

World-class athletes try to be my 
apprentice just to steal my skills.

But...my muscles are cramping, so I 
can't really play basketball right now.
Huh!?

What are you talking about!?
Save that stuff for the girls!

Or wait, did you come out or 
something and not tell me!?

Yeah, it'd suck if I got injured and 
had to give up on being an astronaut.
Let's work on our warm ups, then.

Oh, hold on. Is it possible to get 
injured doing warm ups?

If that's the case, then we better 
do some pre-warm up warm ups...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaito looks deep in thought...
(Damn it...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaito's inner thoughts...?
